page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 16 vCPUs, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, translating to 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and relies on a KVM hypervisor. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10 percent. However, multi-core performance is more robust, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all ranking in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is positioned as a general-purpose resource. It is suitable for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage all 16 cores, such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and software compilation, which perform in the average tier. It is less suited for single-threaded tasks or heavy memory-bound applications. Qualitatively, it offers a stable, dedicated hardware profile for standard enterprise workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory or storage-optimized instances.
